title: GramSevakMLFeatureRegistry
description: Authoritative registry of model-ready input features for Panchayat-level rainfall downscaling under the Phase 2.1 ML Data Contract.

target_definition.name: actual_rainfall_mm
target_definition.description: Ground truth 24-hour observed precipitation at Gram Panchayat. Strictly isolated as prediction target y and forbidden from feature matrix X.

features.name: block_forecast_rainfall_mm
features.missing_policy: Forbidden to be null; records with null block forecast are ineligible for ML.
features.description: Primary regional numerical weather prediction (NWP) 24-hour precipitation forecast issued by IMD/NCMRWF at block scale.

features.name: log1p_block_forecast_rainfall_mm
features.missing_policy: Derived from block_forecast_rainfall_mm via log1p. Handles zeros smoothly and normalizes skewed precipitation distribution.
features.description: Natural logarithm of (1 + block_forecast_rainfall_mm) to compress severe right-skewness while preserving 0 mm dry-day identity.

features.name: panchayat_latitude
features.missing_policy: Forbidden to be null; static administrative centroid coordinate.
features.description: Centroid latitude (WGS84) of the Gram Panchayat, capturing the North-South climatic precipitation gradient.

features.name: panchayat_longitude
features.missing_policy: Forbidden to be null; static administrative centroid coordinate.
features.description: Centroid longitude (WGS84) of the Gram Panchayat, capturing the orographic distance from the Western Ghats ridgeline.

features.name: elevation_m
features.missing_policy: Static terrain altitude above mean sea level. Non-null float.
features.description: Terrain elevation in meters, acting as the primary physical driver of localized orographic precipitation enhancement.

features.name: station_distance_km
features.missing_policy: Great-circle Haversine distance between Panchayat centroid and reference weather station. Non-null float.
features.description: Geometric proximity in kilometers to the nearest reference Automatic Weather Station (AWS) / Rain Gauge.

features.name: station_latitude
features.missing_policy: Latitude of reference weather station (WGS84). Non-null float.
features.description: Geographical latitude of the reference Automatic Weather Station.

features.name: station_longitude
features.missing_policy: Longitude of reference weather station (WGS84). Non-null float.
features.description: Geographical longitude of the reference Automatic Weather Station.

features.name: lead_days
features.missing_policy: Computed as (date - forecast_issue_date). Must be an integer >= 0.
features.description: Forecast lead horizon in integer days, accounting for temporal decay of numerical weather model predictive skill.

features.name: target_month
features.missing_policy: Extracted deterministically from target date. Non-null integer.
features.description: Calendar month of the forecast target date, identifying pre-monsoon, peak monsoon, and post-monsoon phases.

features.name: target_day_of_year
features.missing_policy: Extracted deterministically from target date. Non-null integer.
features.description: Sequential day of the year (1 to 366) of the forecast target date.

features.name: target_day_of_year_sin
features.missing_policy: sin(2 * pi * day_of_year / 365.25). Non-null float.
features.description: Sine cyclical transformation of day of year to preserve annual continuity across calendar boundary.

features.name: target_day_of_year_cos
features.missing_policy: cos(2 * pi * day_of_year / 365.25). Non-null float.
features.description: Cosine cyclical transformation of day of year to preserve annual continuity across calendar boundary.

features.name: historical_rainfall_prior_1d_mm
features.leakage_risk: low (strictly prior to forecast issuance date)
features.missing_policy: NaN when prior day observation is not available in historical record (e.g. warm-up window or snapshot datasets). Never filled with 0 unless actually observed.
features.description: Observed 24-hour rainfall at Panchayat on the day strictly prior to forecast issuance (forecast_issue_date - 1 day).

features.name: historical_rainfall_prior_2d_mm
features.leakage_risk: low (strictly prior to forecast issuance date)
features.missing_policy: NaN when observation on (forecast_issue_date - 2 days) is missing. Never filled with 0 unless actually observed.
features.description: Observed 24-hour rainfall at Panchayat two days prior to forecast issuance (forecast_issue_date - 2 days).

features.name: historical_rainfall_prior_3d_mean_mm
features.leakage_risk: low (strictly backward rolling window prior to forecast issuance)
features.missing_policy: NaN if fewer than 2 valid observations are available in the 3-day backward window [issue - 3d, issue - 1d].
features.description: Mean daily precipitation over the 3-day window strictly prior to forecast issuance, indicating short-term antecedent soil moisture.

features.name: historical_rainfall_prior_3d_sum_mm
features.leakage_risk: low (strictly backward rolling window prior to forecast issuance)
features.missing_policy: NaN if fewer than 2 valid observations are available in the 3-day backward window [issue - 3d, issue - 1d].
features.description: Total accumulated precipitation over the 3-day window strictly prior to forecast issuance.

features.name: historical_rainfall_prior_7d_mean_mm
features.leakage_risk: low (strictly backward rolling window prior to forecast issuance)
features.missing_policy: NaN if fewer than 4 valid observations are available in the 7-day backward window [issue - 7d, issue - 1d].
features.description: Mean daily precipitation over the 7-day window strictly prior to forecast issuance, capturing active monsoon wet/dry spell status.

features.name: historical_rainfall_prior_7d_sum_mm
features.leakage_risk: low (strictly backward rolling window prior to forecast issuance)
features.missing_policy: NaN if fewer than 4 valid observations are available in the 7-day backward window [issue - 7d, issue - 1d].
features.description: Total 7-day accumulated precipitation strictly prior to forecast issuance.

features.name: has_historical_rainfall_context
features.missing_policy: Always non-null (1.0 if historical features are present, 0.0 if in warm-up period or snapshot dataset).
features.description: Explicit indicator flag denoting whether valid antecedent historical observations were available at forecast issuance time.

excluded_features.name: actual_rainfall_mm
excluded_features.reason: Target variable y. Including actual rainfall as an input feature causes catastrophic 100% target leakage.

excluded_features.name: panchayat_id
excluded_features.reason: Raw administrative integer identifier. Causes tree-based models to memorize specific Panchayats rather than learning generalizable geographic relationships.

excluded_features.name: panchayat_name
excluded_features.reason: High-cardinality text categorical identifier with 1,300+ classes. Risk of severe overfitting on training entities.

excluded_features.name: station_id
excluded_features.reason: Categorical station identifier prone to memorizing station-specific calibration artifacts. Replaced by continuous station geometric features.

excluded_features.name: source_row_id
excluded_features.reason: ETL pipeline sequence number; no meteorological or spatial physical relevance.

excluded_features.name: source_file
excluded_features.reason: ETL pipeline file path; no physical relevance.

excluded_features.name: source_dataset
excluded_features.reason: District jurisdiction string; models should generalize across geographic coordinates rather than memorizing dataset labels.
